summary.headline: Question Concerning a Kingdom
summary.text: Chapter IX gives a horary example concerning whether a promised kingdom will be obtained, listing the ascendant, midheaven, planetary positions, and testimonies. Mercury retrograde, the Sun’s sextile to Saturn, and Mars’s degree-by-degree conjunction with Saturn determine the judgment.
